content.short: Pulley is a token management platform that supports Web3 companies from idea to launch.
content.description: Pulley helps Web3 startups compliantly manage, track, and distribute tokens and equity. Users can create agreements with custom legal documents, oversee vesting and distributions, and stay compliant with tax withholdings. The suite supports issuing equity and tokens (RSUs/RTUs, warrants, token warrants), collecting signatures, generating board consents, and updating the cap table. It tracks vesting, lock-ups and settlements, and prepares distributions as vesting occurs. Distributions can be approved directly or exported as reports, with token valuations to support audit-defensible values and withholding calculations.
content.meta: Pulley enables Web3 startups to compliantly manage, track and distribute tokens. Discover Pulley and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: 409A Valuation: Complete Guide for CFOs and Founders
resources.tldr: You need a 409A before issuing your first option, and it sets the strike price your team's equity is measured against. Covers why getting it wrong creates tax and legal exposure later.

resources.title: ASC 718 Stock Compensation: Compliance Guide
resources.tldr: The FASB standard governing how stock-based compensation is measured and reported, applying from your first priced round. Deficiencies here delay financings and complicate M&A.

resources.title: What Is the Alternative Minimum Tax (AMT)?
resources.tldr: AMT is a second federal tax system running parallel to the ordinary one: above a threshold you compute your liability twice and pay whichever is higher. Also asks why it exists at all.
